name: VoidAI
description: VoidAI lists daily credits on its no-card free API plan.
overview: The free plan includes 125,000 credits per day for eligible models. Credits are not tokens: input, output and base costs vary by model. Listings do not guarantee live service availability; Claude access requires approval. Check the model catalog and service status before relying on a route.
free_access: Free model list may change; live availability not guaranteed
notes: Use https://api.voidai.app/v1; review model credit costs and current status.
